title: fix(backup): restore snapshots from older schemas
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Healthy SQLite snapshots taken before a schema-bumping upgrade cannot be verified or restored because verification applies the current-schema compaction guard.

Fixes #170244

## User Impact

Operators can verify and fresh-restore supported older shared-state and agent snapshots. Restore preserves their bytes, and the running version owns migration when the restored database is opened. Newer schemas, invalid or mismatched version metadata, wrong owners, corrupt artifacts, and occupied restore targets remain refused.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared snapshot validator now checks the supported schema version and canonical ownership independently of current table/index definitions. Snapshot creation retains strict current-schema validation before compaction. SQLite and Git snapshot restore use the same validator. No schema, dependency, or public option changes are needed.

## Evidence

- Original adapter: both regressions fail at verification with the “run openclaw doctor --fix before compacting it” error, using shared schema 20 and agent schema 25.
- Rebased head: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/snapshot/local-repository.schema-versions.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` passes both tests: 11.0 seconds of test time, 50.1 seconds wall time. Covers historical layouts, verify/fresh restore, byte preservation, newer-version refusal, mismatched/zero versions, and wrong roles.
- Before the patch-identical rebase, all 13 additional import-related test files completed: 207 tests passed, 4 platform-specific tests skipped on macOS, 481.2 seconds wall time. Includes CLI backup, Git backup, artifact corruption, cold transcripts, and copied-state lease behavior.
- A pre-existing Git backup case took 31.1 seconds while executing three fresh CLI children plus real Git/SQLite backups; its timeout and assertions are unchanged.
- Isolated Codex review: clean through P2; rebase made no changes to the reviewed patch.
- `node scripts/check-changed.mjs --base 582b6dd0041c811fe8dbd24dd88aa33b448b8223 --head 270896aeceb67f9cf911d35c5e015aef9436a433 --timed`: changed-file checks, production typecheck, and all 28 test typecheck groups passed. The full check exited 1 at the Knip export scan after 155.3 seconds. The earlier QA Lab export failure is fixed in the rebased base.
- The seven remaining Knip findings are inherited from main, unrelated to this patch, and left untouched: `scripts/lib/postgres-schema-catalog.mts: literal`; `src/agents/failover-error.ts: hasProviderRequestSizeCeiling`; `src/tts/tts.ts: getResolvedSpeechProviderConfig`; `ui/src/app/app-root.tsx: OpenClawApp`; `ui/src/app/app-shell-view.tsx: ApplicationShell`; `ui/src/app/shell-layout-traits.ts: ShellLayoutController`; `extensions/workboard/src/test/postgres-fixture-contract.ts: PostgresFixtureReply`. All seven files are unchanged on this branch and on subsequently fetched main `151cf8db96f9`. Maintainer direction accepts the passing scoped proof for publication without deleting potentially in-flight exports.

Production: +33/-13 lines (net +20). Tests: +138 lines. Documentation: +3/-1 lines. PR CI timing is not yet available.
